title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Hold Share for Military Discount Tenants
content:
The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental hold military share depends on the military discount on the renter's storage agreements, as recorded on the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records: an active agreement carrying it takes **0.8** of the card deposit, a renter whose only such agreement is vacated takes **0.9**, and any other renter keeps the card deposit as it is.

| Storage agreements carrying the military discount | Share of the card deposit |
|---|---|
| At least one active | 0.8 |
| None active; one vacated | 0.9 |
| One that is neither active nor vacated, and no other | As it is |
| None | As it is |

Illustration (hypothetical): a credit card deposit of 200.00 becomes 160.00 for a renter with an active storage agreement carrying the military discount, and 180.00 for a renter whose only such agreement is vacated.
